She played 54 minutes against Michigan State at the Big Ten tournament on Nov. 3, her longest appearance of the season.\u003Cbr>\u003Cbr>\u003Cstrong>Before Nebraska\u003C/strong>\u003Cbr>Prososki was a midfielder who went to Omaha Marian High School. Her 2020 season was cancelled due to COVID-19. Individually, Prososki earned a varsity letter in 2018-21, was a Lincoln Journal Star Class A All-State honoree, a Lincoln Journal Star Super State second-team honoree, an Omaha World-Herald All-Class Metro first-team honoree, an Omaha World-Herald Class A All-Nebraska second-team honoree in 2021. She also participated in cross country in high school and lettered in 2018. Academically, she was been a member of the honor roll from 2018-21 and was an NSAA Academic All-State Honoree in 2021. She also was a member of the National Honor Society in 2020-21.\u003Cbr> \u003Cbr>As a member of the Gretna Elite Academy, Prososki was coached by Mitch Kavanagh and helped her team to a Nebraska State Cup Championship in 2017. Her team was also a Cup A ECNL National Semifinalist in 2021.
